props.name: text
props.description: The text to animate, one character per cell.

props.name: style
props.description: Extra inline CSS appended to the element's style attribute.

props.name: shuffleDirection
props.description: Direction each character slides in from: `left`, `right`, `up`, or `down`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one character to complete its slide.

props.name: maxDelay
props.description: Upper bound in seconds for random stagger delays in `random` mode.

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing name such as `power3.out`, or a custom easing function.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before the shuffle starts.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: IntersectionObserver root margin, e.g. `-100px`, shrinking the trigger area.

props.name: tag
props.description: Element the text is rendered as: `h1`–`h6`, `p`, or `span`.

props.name: textAlign
props.description: CSS text-align value for the element.

props.name: onShuffleComplete
props.description: Called each time a shuffle cycle finishes.

props.name: shuffleTimes
props.description: How many scramble clones each character slides through.

props.name: animationMode
props.description: Stagger pattern: `evenodd` interleaves two groups, `random` gives each character a random delay.

props.name: loop
props.description: Repeat the shuffle after each cycle.

props.name: loopDelay
props.description: Seconds to wait before each loop restarts.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between consecutive character delays.

props.name: scrambleCharset
props.description: Characters used for the scramble clones; empty means each clone shows the real character.

props.name: colorFrom
props.description: Colour the characters interpolate from; needs `colorTo` to take effect.

props.name: colorTo
props.description: Colour the characters interpolate to; needs `colorFrom` to take effect.

props.name: triggerOnce
props.description: Stop observing after the first intersection.

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Show the plain text immediately when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: triggerOnHover
props.description: Replay the shuffle when the pointer enters the element.

components.componentComment:
Animates text in by sliding each character through a scramble strip, with optional colour
interpolation and scroll, hover or loop triggers.

@example
```svelte
<ShuffleText text="MACHINES UI" tag="h2" />
```
